supplier_public_screen.scope: Independent read-only public JLCPCB pages while retention executor ran; no design upload, account action, quote configuration, coupon claim or order.
supplier_public_screen.via_geometry: Current Drilling table distinguishes via hole/diameter from component PTH pads: via diameter at least hole+0.10 mm, hole+0.15 mm preferred; preferred hole minimum0.20 mm. Both retained via families exceed these nominal dimensional differences. This is not approval of the complete filled/capped process.
supplier_public_screen.PTH_ring: Current Traces table separately gives multilayer1oz component PTH ring recommended0.20 mm, absolute minimum0.15 mm. Do not apply this PTH row as an asserted via minimum or use an older Q&A/search summary as current specification.
supplier_public_screen.fill_process: Via-covering article explicitly describes nonconductive epoxy followed by copper plating, distinct from soldermask plugging and conductive copper-paste filling. Retain the required resin/planarization/capping duty; no substitution selected.
supplier_public_screen.process_ambiguity: Capabilities table says via diameters0.15-0.55 mm without clearly disambiguating hole versus land; detailed article says filled via HOLES <=0.50 mm. The actual0.30/0.35 mm holes meet the latter, but the inconsistency and cap/planarity acceptance must be resolved for a selected process.
supplier_public_screen.six_layer_cost_evidence: Official pages advertise free resin-filled/capped via-in-pad for6+ layers (multilayer page6-32). Marketing starts at$2 for5 six-layer50x50mm ENIG2uin boards. The45x49.35mm study bounds fit that nominal size envelope, not proof of eligibility, delivered price, assembly price or a quote.
supplier_public_screen.four_layer_process_and_price: Not established for this exact required process by these pages. Do not infer unavailable, free or cheaper.
supplier_public_screen.next_limit: Actual named4/6-layer constructions, full process/cap quality, exact order scope and cost remain required. Public via guidance does not waive the returned diagnostic project's0.15mm rule or authorize source edits.

reference_partition.partition_status: Preferred first-comparison strategy only. Exact protected-copper and external-terminal inventory must pass before these 18 references become an approved retained block. No new fixed poses applied.
reference_partition.reason: Preserve the two source-reviewed power/private-pickoff cells rather than relying on heuristic clustering for same-net topology. Leave MCU/power escape, crystal, QSPI and other ordinary placement flexible. This is not preservation of all existing routes or a generic source-cell solution.

retained_copper_strategy.contact_representation: Reuse the demonstrated source-bound feeds plus eight B track/via/pour guards, subject to full-input qualification. Preserve the exact intentional source-feed overlaps and compare all added copper independently; no new feed holes, flag removal or blanket DRC suppression.
critical_block_inventory_required: Actual R26.2 to R27.2 private pickoff, independent until the native R27.2 land
Actual R24.2 to C28.2 private ground pickoff, independent until the native C28.2 land
U5.6 to C27.1/C28.1 supply and U5.4 to C27.2/C28.2 return paths; U5.5 to L1.P$2 switch path
CELL_NEG branch duties at Q5.A1/C1 and C30.2/U6.4/R28.2, separate from PROT_FET_RETURN
Every external terminal/junction, extra via, component-relative rule area and same-net branch touched by retained copper
retained_copper_strategy.selection_rule: Select source identities and electrical duties, not every shape inside a rectangle or every shape on a whole net. Do not retain the entire old GND plane to avoid enumerating return ports. A cut through a branch or joined copper needs explicit port/restoration treatment.
retained_copper_strategy.obsolete_copper: Ordinary replaceable copper outside the subsequently approved retention set may be removed only in qualified disposable preparation. Boundary inventory precedes removal; no actual removal is released here.

geometry_and_access.shared_trial_domain: D45 plus original USB tongue, 45 x 49.35 mm, with +2 mm speaker spacing; no global scaling or new enclosure build.
geometry_and_access.F_height_policy: Pre-intersect actual physical-body/rotation constraints with F placement domains. L1 requires a peripheral domain outside nominal R11.1 magnet planning exclusion; source whole-body example passes but arbitrary positions do not.
geometry_and_access.fixed_planning_reservations: Retain R3.2 mount domains, fixed J1/J2 proxies and existing X6 overhang/B-anchor reservation. J2 already includes 0.7 mm planning allowance.
geometry_and_access.remaining_geometric_gates: Explicit domain polygons and native/import semantics; complete cable/latch/driver/recovery access; loaded contact motion and tolerance/insulation. These are not zero-clearance assumptions, and plastic adaptability is not a waiver.
geometry_and_access.placement_import_gate: On-board or edge-overlapping F regions with reviewed manual KiCad assignments, not off-board grouping hints. Assigned regions combine by union. Movable F-only behavior remains unexercised.

via_and_stackup_disposition.five_existing_ordinary_vias: Prefer exact retention of the five 0.600/0.300 mm contact-feed vias as existing geometry, not a new-via template. They have 0.150 mm nominal rings; supplier acceptance and full-board isolation remain required. No resizing or removal approved.
via_and_stackup_disposition.mandatory_U4_vias: Preserve four 0.604/0.350 mm filled/planarized/capped vias with 0.127 mm rings. A 0.150 mm global annular rule conflicts with these exact seeds; no process waiver.
via_and_stackup_disposition.mandatory_C24_via: Preserve the 0.600/0.300 mm filled/planarized/capped seed; ordinary geometry equality does not remove its special-process obligation.
via_and_stackup_disposition.new_ordinary_via_minima: Existing 0.604/0.350 mm values are lower bounds, not a compatible diameter/drill pair for every supplier rule. Require diameter >= drill + 2*selected_annular_minimum as well as those lower bounds. A 0.150 mm ring with 0.350 mm drill requires at least 0.650 mm diameter; this derivation is not an approved new size or supplier selection.
via_and_stackup_disposition.stackup_gate: Select actual supplier four/six-layer constructions compatible with the preserved process seeds before impedance routing. Do not copy the diagnostic's two-inner-GND profile or its minima as product approval. In1 remains protected GND.

packaging_flexibility.purpose: Permit modest packaging changes to enable efficient layout while retaining the general printed-bell shape. Defer coordinated enclosure adaptation until a layout is worth retaining.
packaging_flexibility.diameter_interpretation: Main PCB body diameter, not full contact-tab/USB-tongue bounds. No global scaling of the native outline, footprint/pad geometry or real parts.
packaging_flexibility.axial_interpretation: For sensitivity only, move the PCB and its contact/cell stack towards the handle, keeping the speaker station fixed. Preserve board-to-contact-to-cell datums; additional space on F consumes rear-stack room.
may_adapt: Nominal board body outline within the confirmed range, with exact noncircular interfaces explicitly reconstructed
Printed yoke/supports, PCB mounting support geometry, cartridge, cell cradle/cover and USB bezel
Shell dimensions/profile by a corresponding small amount while retaining the general bell shape
not_scalable_or_waived: Component footprints, pads, MPNs, physical bodies/heights, speaker and cell dimensions
Contact separation/loaded-fit obligations, insulation and CELL_NEG versus protected GND
Fastener threads, head/washer/nut fit, engagement and service/assembly access
Connector mating, cable/latch access, recovery pads, structural/load paths and required skin/insulation thickness
Five mandatory process vias and all electrical/current/return/stackup requirements
packaging_flexibility.initial_xy_policy: Keep the nine current fixed reference poses and five process vias for the first comparison, avoiding unnecessary variables. Printed support shape is not fixed. Mount/connector XY changes require an exact interface disposition; contact pairs and process seeds must not be independently stretched or scaled.
packaging_flexibility.cad_policy: Saved assembly is reference geometry, not a mandatory immutable-support placement mask. Defer rebuilding/exporting all enclosure pieces until selection; carry source-bound component/contact/hardware/access reservations and an explicit adaptation ledger beforehand.
packaging_flexibility.comparison_policy: Use the four endpoint geometry cases as a cheap sensitivity calculation, not four cloud jobs. Select one qualified packaging envelope shared by the four/six-layer comparison.

recovery_authorization.first_item: Repair inventory API and evidence/geometry semantics; at most three native executions in ten minutes, stopping by 14:34 local.

historical_failed_inventory.root_disposition: Do not rerun after only an accessor change. Failed script also needs source-evidenced keepout classification, complete polygons including holes, explicit fill-read failures, correct fitted-component counting and geometric process-via pad binding.

owner_authorization.purpose: Personal learning: efficient owner/agent/dedicated-layout-service workflow, not preservation of sunk cost or aesthetic optimization.
owner_authorization.later_trials: Qualified comparable four/six-layer inputs; eight layers only if little additional preparation/review and confirmed free.
not_authorized: Public redistribution of Quilter native output without license review

source.identity_policy: Preserve complete footprint/pad definitions, duplicate and unnumbered pads, UUIDs, nets, values, MPNs, DNP/assembly flags and schematic. No part substitutions.

fixed_interfaces.pose_source: Exact accepted native footprint poses, not older landmarks or proxy centers.
fixed_interfaces.board_outline: Preserve the exact source Edge.Cuts as evidence. A disposable trial may use the approved D43-45 main-body envelope only after exact tab/USB-tongue continuity and interface clearance review; no global scaling.
fixed_interfaces.mechanics: Retain real mount/hardware, USB mating/service, connector access, speaker/body and conductive-contact obligations. Printed supports/enclosure may adapt under packaging_flexibility; exact full mechanical rebind is required before acceptance, not at every layout iteration.

initial_process_seeds.reason: Preserve mandatory process-via geometry without falsely assuming Quilter can move a footprint and its independent vias as a rigid group.
initial_process_seeds.geometry_source: Exact current PCB; verify against reports/imu-closure-acceptance.json and reports/c24-filled-via-acceptance.json.
initial_process_seeds.alternative: Relocatable seed or ordinary-via substitution requires separate explicit engineering review; do not silently delete these obligations.

functional_groups.intent: Fixed mechanical interfaces; raw negative is not system ground.
Movable MCU and complete supply/return cells. Associate capacitors with exact source pins, not all with U2.
Move with MCU relationship; short crystal paths, actual 15pF load capacitors, keep noisy switching copper away.
Local QSPI and flash supply/return, retain boot recovery branch and short test stubs.
Fixed X6; movable termination/CC parts and probe pads. USB approximately 90ohm differential, referenced to real stackup.
Local dual-supply decoupling; C24 process seed fixed initially. Record any IC4 rotation for sensor-to-bell frame mapping.
Local regulator input/output capacitors with short ground returns.
Retain charge program, enable access and indication; near fixed USB/power interfaces without imposing an invented region size.
Keep source selection and paired load/return corridors; preserve corrected custom Q3 lands.
Power gating and default-off behavior; coordinate with boost input and source selection.
Tight input and output switching loops; C27/C28 local paired returns; quiet R24-to-C28 pickoff; C29 remains DNP.
Preserve separate CELL_NEG, PROT_FET_RETURN and GND; no shunt/FET bypass; independent R26-to-R27 quiet pickup.
U4 seed/J1 fixed initially; local PVDD return and paired speaker paths. VO+/VO- are class-D outputs, not a 100ohm data pair.
Fixed connector, movable input filter with local ground.
Retain status function; no unqualified external visibility promise.
Retain SWD recovery access and usable service-pad placement.

placement_encoding.movable_policy: Every reference not in fixed_interfaces or initial_process_seeds is eligible for XY/rotation changes on F, subject to height, access, footprint, return and electrical constraints.
placement_encoding.staging: After qualification, move eligible footprints outside the NEW trial outline only on isolated input; preserve definitions/pads after translation. Merely unlocking or enlarging the old board leaves on-board parts preplaced in Quilter. Verify imported movable population and retained-via placement obstacles.
placement_encoding.front_requirement: Associate all movable references with actual F.Cu placement regions. A single-sided result filter is not enforcement.
placement_encoding.grouping: Prefer broad anchored groups and source-pin associations; do not copy the old tightly packed floorplan as restrictive rooms.
placement_encoding.region_combination: Quilter combines multiple regions assigned to one reference by union, not intersection. Pre-intersect all requirements into that reference's allowed domain before encoding allowed patches; do not combine a broad F room and a narrow room as if both restrictions apply.
placement_encoding.unqualified: Trial allowed-domain geometry for the selected flexible envelope, height/contact/access reservations and component associations need native/import controls before submission. Existing plastic-support shapes are not immutable keepouts.

copper_policy.diagnostic_track: Do not change or refill raw outputs. Measure actual cached copper.
copper_policy.fresh_track: Proposed removal of replaceable ordinary tracks/vias/pours is confined to new disposable input after the full_input_contract_disposition retention/boundary inventory and keepout classification. Preserve five exact process vias, all footprint copper, and any explicitly approved contact/critical-block copper; do not infer an approved set from group names alone.
copper_policy.keepouts: Classify fixed mechanical versus component-relative electrical exclusions. Do not retain obsolete coordinate-bound crystal/private-return holes as if they followed moved parts; do not simply discard the underlying requirements.
copper_policy.same_net_private_paths: Whole-net continuity is insufficient for R26/R27 and R24/C28; require native cut/topology proofs or preserve an explicitly reviewed small circuit block if service cannot express the duty.

minimum_geometry_contract.width_policy: Preserve engineering net intent; current/path-specific widths and actual stackup impedance govern. No generic 500mA defaults or imported weaker minima as waivers.

stackup_study.qualification: Actual named supplier construction, copper weights, dielectric thickness/properties and layer roles required before impedance-dependent routing. No invented stackup.
stackup_study.more_layers: Define explicit ground adjacency and paired power/return strategy for each construction; more copper layers do not remove through-via contact restrictions.
stackup_study.comparison: Same outline/BOM/requirements/minima. Placement may adapt by stackup; outcomes do not isolate layer count alone.

submission_gates: Native prepared input proves all 104 refs/325 physical pad identities and exact fixed/process seed poses.

Selected packaging envelope and source-bound height/contact/USB/hardware-access reservations are encoded and tested; remodelable plastic shapes are separated from real interface requirements. Source rules and old exclusion intent are accounted for.
Exact capacitor-to-pin, crystal, boost, private-return, USB and audio comprehensions are reviewed rather than accepted from prior inference.
Verify actual parsed F-only/group/keepout behavior; unsupported requirement gets an explicit preserve/check disposition.
Named actual stackup and saved fabrication minima are recorded.
Owner account confirms free personal job; stop at any payment or changed terms requiring owner action.
Submission uses sanitized public design only; no KiCad preferences or credentials.
acceptance: No automatic integration regardless of vendor completion percentage.
Fresh layout judged by intended pad/net identity, complete connectivity, mechanical fit, electrical/topology/return behavior and process requirements, not old trace equality.
Matched-context native DRC/parity plus independent all-layer checks; do not conceal weaker returned rules.
Record setup/review/correction effort, agent expense if measurable, actual job price and wall time separately.
Rebind selected exact placement to mechanical assembly before acceptance; no fabrication or powered approval.
